scope: COMMON V1.0 legacy finding revalidation for DRCOM10-001..007

authority.authority_note: The publication contains an internal document revision 1.1 history, but the exact official historical XSD authority remains Common V1.0 plus Enumerations V1.0. No synthetic Common V1.1 XSD authority is inferred.

visual_page_fallbacks.reason: The frozen COMMON_V1.0 Fresh Read explicitly records page 9 as the visible DataAcceptedResponse table; pdftotext does not expose both table labels reliably. The rendered page was inspected directly.
The frozen COMMON_V1.0 Fresh Read records page 18 as the substantive ShortTripStopList table; generic extraction otherwise selects TOC page 6. The rendered page 18 was inspected directly.

visual_findings.DRCOM10-001: Page 30 visibly records document Version 1.1 changes including ScheduledDepartureTime, corrected Connection Min:Max information, TripInformation AdditionalTextMessage type/RouteDirection changes, and RouteDirectionEnumeration. The exact official historical Common V1.0 XSD does not contain those V1.1 additions and retains its V1.0 Connection declarations.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-002: Page 9 visibly presents DataAcceptedResponseData and OperationErrorMessage as two ordinary 1:1 table rows without expressing the XSD choice compositor. Exact XSD and EV-117 establish that either branch alone is valid and both together are invalid.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-003: Page 18 visibly prints ServiceSpecificationWithStateList/ServiceSpecificationWithState with multiplicity 1:*. Exact XSD declares minOccurs=0 maxOccurs=unbounded, and EV-117 confirms an empty list is valid.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-004: Page 15 visibly prints JourneyStopInformation Announcement and FareZone as 0:*. Exact XSD declares each as 0:1; EV-135 confirms one instance is valid and two repeated instances are invalid for each field.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-005: Page 18 visibly models ShortTripStopList with an inner ShortTripStopList child at 1:* and type StopPointTariffInformation. Exact XSD instead declares child ShortTripStop with type ShortTripStopStructure. EV-135 confirms ShortTripStop is valid and the PDF child-name alias ShortTripStopList is invalid. The two referenced V1.0 structures are instance-shape equivalent, so the type-reference mismatch is declaration-semantic rather than separately distinguishable by instance validation.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-006: Page 25 visibly lists DoorCountingObjectClassEnumeration values including Wheelchair and Others. Exact Enumerations V1.0 uses WheelChair and Other; preserved EV-117 executable samples accept the XSD lexemes and reject the PDF-side variants.
visual_findings.DRCOM10-007: Rendered enumeration/table-list pages visibly preserve grouped editorial residue such as 'Common enummerations' and inconsistent GNSS enumeration naming/spelling. These are documentation-only residues and no XML alias or validation rule is derived from them.

DRCOM10-001: Exact V1.0 Connection including required DisplayContent and ExpectedDepatureTime validates.
PDF-side ExpectedDepartureTime is rejected as an alias.
PDF Version-1.1 ScheduledDepartureTime is rejected by the exact V1.0 authority.
DRCOM10-002: EV-117 confirms both branches together invalid.
DRCOM10-003: EV-117 confirms empty ServiceSpecificationWithStateList valid under exact XSD 0:* despite PDF 1:*.
DRCOM10-004: One Announcement valid; two Announcements invalid.
One FareZone valid; two FareZones invalid.
DRCOM10-005: StopPointTariffInformationStructure and ShortTripStopStructure are confirmed instance-shape equivalent in exact V1.0, preventing an overstated instance-level distinction for the type-reference part.
DRCOM10-007: Executable evidence not applicable because the finding groups editorial documentation residue and does not define XML validity behavior.
